title: Tokenization / Field-Transformation Profile v1
description: Per-field desensitisation policy (the 'field transformation policy' of a de-identification pipeline). Declares the scheme, reversibility, owning domain/realm, key epoch, HSM backing, and format/semantic preservation. Chameleon-style tokens are deterministic within a domain and never cross-domain-linkable; key-evolving schemes rotate via epoch tweaks without re-tokenising stored data.

field_selector.description: Which field(s) this profile governs (JSON pointer / column path).

data_class.description: e.g. direct_identifier, quasi_identifier, free_text — aligns to HELL-ER hazard_class.

scheme.description: Desensitisation scheme. *_token = pseudonym; *_encryption = reversible cipher; one_way_* = irreversible.

reversibility.description: Whether the original value is recoverable. one_way schemes are non-reversible by construction.

domain_scope.description: Owning domain/realm. Chameleon tokens are deterministic within this scope only.

cross_domain_linkable.description: Invariant: tokens MUST NOT be linkable across domains (un-linkable identifiers mitigate side-channel leakage). Cross-domain movement happens only via an explicit, policy-gated re-tokenisation tweak.

preserve.description: Output-shape guarantees so masked data still validates downstream.

key.description: Key-evolving tokenization: rotation produces an epoch tweak that updates tokens without full re-tokenisation.

key_ref.description: KMIP/PKCS#11 key handle. Never the key material.

update_tweak_ref.description: Tweak that migrates tokens from epoch n-1 to n (consistency-preserving).

reidentification_class.description: Who may reverse this field; aligns to Metadata Standards witness_retention.
